description: Formats one commit subject as [numero] - [tipo] - [descrição]. Does not commit. Types: feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, perf. If task_id is omitted, the number comes from the current task_[número] branch. If includes_commit is true and called_from is not commit-per-file, next_tool is runrunit_commit_per_file.

called_from.description: Set to commit-per-file to avoid calling that tool back.

includes_commit.description: When true, points next_tool at runrunit_commit_per_file without committing.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the git repository. Required for tools that read or write that repo.

task_id.description: Task number, or task_[número]. Used in branch names and commit subjects.

name: runrunit_format_commit_message
